scope: Supplementary post-selection regression on the existing fully synthetic Korean fixture: 20 families, 40 documents, 60 answerable variants. Native Korean and English-to-Korean controls. Not independent real-case evidence, not used to choose the final model or change its task instruction. Compare existing MiniLM vectors, BM25 and the locked encoder within each pool; compare 40 mixed records vs 20 resolution records separately. No reranker, no abstention calibration; 8 no-answer queries excluded. Primary real-case scores and locked selection remain unchanged.
